source.author: verg
source.text: ipsi per medias acies insignibus alis ingentes animos angusto in pectore versant, usque adeo obnixi non cedere, dum gravis aut hos aut hos versa fuga victor dare terga subegit.
source.text_original: ipsi per medias acies insignibus alis / ingentes animos angusto in pectore versant, / usque adeo obnixi non cedere, dum gravis aut hos / aut hos versa fuga victor dare terga subegit.
source.text_english: They themselves, with their conspicuous wings, amid the ranks, revolve mighty spirits in a narrow breast, so resolutely determined not to yield, until the heavy rout, now turned this way, now that, has forced the victor to turn his back.

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: o si tibi contingeret uidere socrum et cognatam tuam et in paruis corpusculis ingentes animos intueri!
reuse.text_original: o si tibi contingeret uidere socrum et cognatam tuam et in paruis corpusculis ingentes animos intueri!
reuse.text_english: O if it were granted to you to see your mother-in-law and your kinswoman, and to behold great souls in little bodies!
